E-01.reference: 9 ^ 3 leaves the cursor at the exponent end; a digit extends the exponent; ▶ exits after the power

E-17.reference: **Power is a postfix script on the preceding atom.** Typing before a power's base joins that atom (29³); one cursor stop before the base; DEL at the exponent start splices "9▌3"

E-02.reference: ▼ from an exponent: no-op at root level; to the denominator when the power is in a numerator (outward walk)

E-04.reference: ▶ at root end wraps to root start

E-05.reference: ◀ at root start wraps to root end

E-06.reference: ▶ at the end of a numerator leaves the fraction

E-07.reference: ◀ at the start of a denominator (empty or not) leaves to before the fraction

E-08.reference: DEL with nothing to the left deletes forward: at root offset 0 the next item; at a fraction's numerator start when the fraction has nothing to its left, the numerator's first item

E-09.reference: DEL directly after a structure deletes its last field's last item

E-10.reference: DEL at the start of a non-first field (empty or not) removes the structure and splices all field contents in order; cursor at the splice point

E-11.reference: SHIFT DEL (INS) in Math input: the next template key wraps the **following** operand

E-12.reference: SHIFT◀/▶ inside mixed/∫/Σ/Π: to just before/after that template

E-13.reference: TOOLS > Undo undoes the last editing operation, including menu insertions

E-14.reference: after an error, the cursor sits before the offending token (`1×▌×2`)

E-16.reference: function keys insert an open call `sin(`; `)` closes it; DEL removes `)`, contents, then `sin(` as one token

L-03.reference: caret width 3, height = the owning field's box (13 / 9 minimum; 17 with an exponent; 30 beside a fraction), top = box top

L-04.reference: fraction W = content + 4, rule [x+1, x+W), gaps 2/2

L-05.reference: level 2 outside the active field subtree

L-06.reference: ink may extend past the advance

L-08.reference: long-line ◀▶ raster arrows with clipping band

L-09.reference: linear display uses calculator linear tokens

L-11.reference: exponent ink bottom 7 rows above base ink bottom; exponent top at line top

R-01.reference: SHIFT EXE shows the decimal result

R-02.reference: multi-value separator follows the decimal mark (comma for dot-decimal, semicolon for comma-decimal)

R-05.reference: FORMAT items depend on the result; no menu if none applies

R-06.reference: Norm 1 decimal shows 10 significant digits, right-aligned

A-01.reference: ▲▼ browse history showing expression **and answer**; ◀▶/BACK edit it; EXE re-executes

A-02.reference: history browsable from an empty line after AC; ▲ lit

A-03.reference: ◀/▶ on the empty line after AC recall the last expression (cursor end/start)

A-04.reference: AC closes user-opened menus and keeps the expression; FORMAT menu returns to the result

A-05.reference: errors are a modal dialog; OK/AC/BACK dismiss to editing at the error position

A-06.reference: BACK on the Calculate entry opens HOME

A-07.reference: long result: ◀▶ scroll it first; BACK/AC then edit

A-08.reference: SETTINGS root: Calc Settings ▸ / System Settings ▸ / Reset ▸

A-10.reference: CALC: prompts linear; parent keeps its natural display; final EXE; EXE on the CALC result reopens the prompts

A-11.reference: Statistics, Distribution, Table, Spreadsheet, Ratio, MathBox exist

A-12.reference: 2026 fx-880 Home has one more native app

I-01.reference: ▲ lit after AC while history exists

I-02.reference: menus and dialogs clear all segments

I-03.reference: SUN always lit in the emulator

I-04.reference: ◀▶ segments stay off during horizontal scroll

I-06.reference: MATH + angle on entry; newest history entry ▲ only, oldest ▼ only

A-13.reference: C48: BACK on a successful result edits at the expression end; 1 EXE BACK 2 must give 12.
A-13.discovered: P1 full-controller replay: native gives 21 because result.position is used for successful results.
